objective: Improve cold and warm uv dependency-resolution time on a frozen hash-pinned offline PEP 503 index. Exact locks, selected wheel hashes, uv-resolver tests, and peak RSS at or below baseline plus 2% are hard gates; only crates/uv-resolver/src is mutable.

meta.provenance: astral-sh/uv current head 336535f83fd933ea54685e24e3c08468339937ce; frozen universal wheels acquired from PyPI and served only from a local file:// PEP 503 index; the workload exercises the Manifest/Resolver engine benchmarked by crates/uv-bench/benches/uv.rs and follows the resolve-cold/resolve-warm cache preparation in scripts/benchmark/src/benchmark/resolver.py

sourceDetails.protectedSurface: toolchain image, Cargo manifests and lock, benchmark/evaluator code, resolver tests, package index, requirements, expected locks, distribution hashes

toolchain.buildProfile: profiling with debug=0, lto=false, no uv default features, and rust-lld
toolchain.network: none at mutation, build, test, and evaluation time

measurement.platform: native linux/amd64 on Deckbox (AMD Ryzen 9 7900, Docker Engine 29.1.3, cgroup v2)
measurement.q: reference-normalized per-cell speed ratio: within each eval the pristine trusted-baseline reference binary and the candidate are run in interleaved repetition pairs (41 cold pairs each from a freshly mounted candidate-writable tmpfs with private /tmp and /dev/shm; 41 warm pairs each on its own freshly mounted tmpfs seeded from a root-held snapshot of the caches each binary primed once, so no candidate-writable byte survives from one repetition to the next in either mode). Each pair is interleaved rep-by-rep so both binaries share the same instant of the host's permanent repo-watcher load; the per-pair reference/candidate wall-time ratio cancels that shared ambient contention, the 8 most extreme ratios at each end are trimmed, and score = referenceNormalization * geometric-mean(kept ratios). Paired cancellation over 41 pairs drives residual jitter down as 1/sqrt(pairs) far tighter than a min-of-N-per-binary estimator would on these sub-100ms resolutions. Cold and warm latency reflect real resolution, never replay of earlier-repetition state; the readiness-gated timer excludes namespace/mount setup from the measured interval
measurement.rssGate: per-workload peak RSS <= 24000 KiB frozen baseline whole-tree cgroup memory.peak maximum across the A-A suite * 1.02
measurement.qReferenceConstruction: Final native linux/amd64 score anchor from five A-A samples under the accepted frozen evaluator contract. qBase is the sample mean (25.15491792208478) and sigma is the population standard deviation (0.28672275657922736). qReference = qBase + max(5*sigma, 5%*|qBase-qFail|) = 26.58853170498092; the five-sigma floor dominates.
